title: Jesus... My Deadline Is The Day After Diwali
topic: his office set a release deadline the day after Diwali and he is missing the festival at home for it

bible.text: Better one handful with tranquility than two handfuls with toil and pursuit of the wind.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my office set a deadline for the day after Diwali. I opened my laptop on the train home. 💻

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Amma lit the lamps alone. I told her the release is important.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You missed the puja for a file that will ship without your name remembered.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I don't deliver, I look replaceable. Rent doesn't pay itself.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your worth was never measured in overtime. Rest is obedience too, not laziness.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The lamps need you more than the sprint does.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When did work last eat a festival you cared about? 👇
